All three sit at D band as candidate/unverified/link_only and cannot be cited by clinical content until reviewed. The same commit corrected ranzcp-mood-disorders-clinical-practice-guideline from documentStatus current to outdated against the publisher's own page, preserving the 2026-09-06 review. Next action: owner reviews each of the three against its publisher page and records the outcome, and confirms the RANZCP currentness correction.
